{{Quotation|game|[[Duke Barradin]]'s family estate covers nearly two hundred hectars of [[Green Hills County]]. The duke's vineyard is known throughout [[Ascalon]] for the exquisite grapes it produces, which are used to make Amethyst, the most coveted wine in the kingdom.}}

==Getting there==
Located in the heart of Green Hills County. Head north from [[Ashford Abbey]] or west from [[Ascalon City]] into Green Hills County. Then head southwest and west. The quest [[Little Thom's Big Cloak]] leads here.
